notes.title: Update 0.4 !
notes.content:
Hello everyone , I have a great news the update 0.4 is almost here ! 

I have redesigned the game and improved the HTC vive support , enjoy the experience.

I have faced some budget trouble and time because I'm the only developer of this game so If you want to increase the development speed of it you can talk about this game to your fellows thank you and good game !
